edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender() and used to derive ownership and transfer senders
transfer and transferFrom use _msgSender() as the sender address for _transfer
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _developmentAddress/_marketingAddress
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _developmentAddress/_marketingAddress
owner is set from msg.sender in the constructor and validated by onlyOwner
owner() returns the _owner state variable
_transfer allows the owner to bypass max tx, blacklist and trading restrictions
_transfer inspects uniswapV2Pair to decide fee tiers and whether to trigger a swap
_transfer conditionally invokes swapTokensForEth, introducing an external call path
swapTokensForEth executes the router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating a timestamp dependency
_transfer calls sendETHToFee after swapping, performing an ETH transfer to an external address
sendETHToFee forwards ETH via the _marketingAddress.transfer external call
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth after authorizing the caller
manualsend calls sendETHToFee after authorizing the caller
_developmentAddress is compared to msg.sender in manualswap authorization
_marketingAddress is compared to msg.sender in manualsend authorization
_marketingAddress is the recipient of the risky ETH transfer
setTrading writes the tradingOpen state variable
tradingOpen gates whether non-owner transfers are allowed in _transfer
bots blacklist mapping is checked in _transfer to reject blocked addresses
_maxTxAmount limits transfer amount in _transfer
_maxWalletSize limits recipient wallet size in _transfer
_swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold that triggers the contract swap
_redisFee influences computed transfer amounts in _transfer
_taxFee influences fee computation for transfers
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the external swap call
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned balances using SafeMath sub/add
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal using SafeMath sub
_reflectFee accumulates _tFeeTotal
_takeTeam adds reflected team tokens to the contract _rOwned balance
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRValues
_getValues calls _getRate
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply
_getRate divides reflection supply derived from _rTotal
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to convert reflection to token amounts
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection on the account reflection balance
transfer invokes _transfer with _msgSender() as sender
transferFrom invokes _transfer with an arbitrary sender and allowance accounting
transferFrom updates allowance via _approve
approve sets allowance via _approve for the caller
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
setFee is onlyOwner and writes fee state variables
setFee writes the sell-side fee state variable with owner privilege
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is onlyOwner and updates the swap threshold
toggleSwap is onlyOwner and toggles swapEnabled
setMaxTxnAmount is onlyOwner and sets the max transaction amount
setMaxWalletSize is onlyOwner and sets the max wallet size
blockBots writes the bots blacklist mapping
unblockBot removes an address from the bots blacklist
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFee mapping
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees are applied in _transfer
the receive() fallback accepts ETH and can be triggered during external transfers or callbacks
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) clears the _owner state variable
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) updates _owner to a new address

_tradingOpen is assigned to the tradingOpen state variable in setTrading
maxTxAmount is assigned to _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxnAmount
contractTokenBalance is computed and passed directly into swapTokensForEth
